title: The Impact of Annotator Personas on LLM Behavior Across the Perspectivism Spectrum
reasoning: The study investigates how LLMs adopt personas when annotating hate speech and abusiveness, focusing on 'perspectivism' in dataset creation. While it utilizes demographic personas that include religious identifiers (e.g., 'Muslim migrant'), the paper's focus is on annotation alignment and modeling techniques rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious doctrines, faith traditions, or ethical/moral systems.
